title: Retention: archive the text of finished documents
description:
Legal asked us not to keep the full text of contracts and claims forever once their review is over; the decisions and the audit trail must stay. This adds a retention period and a job that archives finished documents.

- New settings under `workflow.retention`: `finished-after` (default P365D), `resubmit-window` (default P30D) and `batch-size` (default 100, 1–1000). Negative durations fail the startup; `WorkflowConfig` gains the nested `Retention` record.
- A rejected document can now be resubmitted only within `resubmit-window` of its rejection; after that the rejection is final and `resubmit` answers 409 `invalid-transition` (`DocumentStateMachine.resubmit` takes the window).
- `ArchiveService.archiveFinished` locks up to one batch of finished documents (approved, withdrawn, rejected) whose last change is older than `finished-after`, oldest first, with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` so several instances share the work, and archives them through `DocumentStateMachine.archive`: the body is replaced by a marker and the new `archived` flag is set. The last change time is left alone. `ArchiveJob` runs it on the job interval when scheduling is on.
- `GET /documents/{id}` returns `archived`, and no body for an archived document. Title, tasks, decisions and audit rows are kept.
- Migration V3 adds `document.archived` and a partial index for the job's query.
- README: the resubmit window, a Retention concept, the new settings and the document route.

Tests: approved and withdrawn documents archived exactly at the end of the period while drafts and documents under review are not, the detail of an archived document, the resubmit window, a final rejection archived after the period, the state machine and the settings validation.

bugs.summary: ArchiveService treats REJECTED as finished as soon as it is rejected: FINISHED lists it next to APPROVED and WITHDRAWN and the only cutoff is now - finished-after, so the resubmit window is ignored. The README (and DocumentStateMachine.resubmit) say a rejected document stays open to resubmission for resubmit-window and only then becomes final. Whenever finished-after is shorter than resubmit-window (both are settings; updated_at of a rejected document is its rejection time), a rejected document whose owner can still resubmit has its body destroyed; the owner's resubmit then succeeds and sends the archive marker out for review as the document's text, and the original text is lost.
bugs.trigger: finished-after PT0S (or any value under the window), resubmit-window P30D: reject a document, run the archive job the next day: its body becomes "(archived)" although the owner may resubmit it for another 29 days; resubmitting starts round 2 with the marker as body.
bugs.false_rebuttal: A rejected document cannot be archived inside its window: the retention period is 365 days by default and the resubmit window 30 days (application.yml), so any document past finished-after is long past its resubmit window, and DocumentStateMachine.resubmit already refuses a resubmit once the window has closed. The two settings do not need to be combined in the archive query.
